caveats: Dataset has no 29 February values (no day-60 observations), so day 60 of the climatology/threshold relies solely on the specified fill (mean of days 59 and 61) before smoothing. The +-5-day baseline windows use spillover days 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 as specified, so values outside 1992-2002 also entered the pools. Grid is 0.02 deg: the region is covered by 60x60 cells (lat 59.06-60.24, lon 21.26-22.44), of which 3290 are sea cells (SST finite on every target day). Per-cell gap joining was implemented as 'join if all gap days are non-hot'; the alternative reading (join any 1-2-day gap) yields an identical mask for this period.
